name: Domains-Database
description: Domains Database - Your Domains, All in One Place. Domain inventory built with Expo, React Native, TypeScript, and Sass, with a read-only server relay for registrar APIs. The full portfolio brings records from Hostinger, GoDaddy, GoDaddy Auctions, and Namecheap into one device-local list.

paragraphs: Domains Database is a domain inventory built with Expo, React Native, TypeScript, and Sass, with Firebase Authentication, private Firestore account storage, and a read-only server relay for registrar APIs. The landing page uses the v8 logo and opens with a compact portfolio. The full portfolio combines registered domains and their custom project details in the signed-in account.

requirements.text: Firebase email/password sign-up and sign-in, Google sign-in on web, session restoration, and avatar sign-out
Expo includes these public values in the client bundle, so moving them out of source does not make the Firebase web API key private; registrar secrets must never use this prefix.
Missing API key, app ID, project ID, or auth domain selects device storage and the existing demo authentication; Google sign-in requires configured Firebase.
